Require vendor-specific draft match predicates, reject needs_review on
revise/accept, and stop treating bare autopay as a credit-card payment.

commits.body:

pin draft assign category to the reviewed proposal, and filter the
AI panel list to the visible inbox.

commits.headline: fix(accounting): address second Codex P2 round on AI propose
commits.body:
Validate draft_rule.assign.scope, scope propose to visible inbox ids,
block Accept while revise is pending, only auto-select confidence ≥0.8,
and prefer profile-scoped Wise transfer detail keys.

commits.headline: fix(accounting): address Codex P1/P2 on AI propose paths
commits.body:
Whitelist draft_rule match keys so unknown keys cannot universal-match,
preserve explicit null draft_rule, revalidate needs_review on accept,
prefer profile-scoped Wise source ids, close AI panel before detail,
and reject reserved txn ids on propose mutations.

Add Ollama-backed (heuristic fallback) categorization proposals on the
Transactions inbox, dual US Schedule C / DE treatment cards, group Accept
with optional save-as-rule, and a detail drawer with full Plaid/Wise source
fields. Never auto-runs — user clicks Propose with AI.

commits.headline: fix(agents): require fixture dispatch smoke to complete
commits.body:
Codex P1: fixture mode waits for status=completed (not mere claim) so
verify:agent-kernel:dispatch proves fake-CLI execution. Live still accepts
claim+ since real research tasks can run long; failures still reject.

commits.headline: fix(agents): resolve branch refs via git-common-dir in worktrees
commits.body:
Linked worktrees keep HEAD under .git/worktrees/<name> while branch tips
live in the common git dir. Use --git-common-dir (+ packed-refs fallback)
so identity cache keys invalidate after pull without restart.

commits.headline: fix(agents): resolve worktree gitdir + wait for dispatch claim
commits.body:
Codex P1s: identity source key now resolves gitdir pointers/worktrees via
git rev-parse --git-dir, and dispatch e2e polls /v1/tasks/:id until claimed
or finished so enqueue-only regressions fail the verify harness.

commits.headline: fix(agents): address Codex P1s on dispatch e2e PR
commits.body:
Keep worker runTask compatibility on the registered startup identity so
git HEAD refresh cannot desync heartbeats from claim checks. Mark the
invented-capabilities live smoke case read-only/research so verify:live
never enqueues a mutating GitHub-identity task.

commits.headline: fix(agents): dispatch e2e + harden runner health for voice
commits.body:
Voice still failed after #1023 when chat kept a stale producer SHA and
health treated overall 503 as kernel-down. Refresh identity when git HEAD
moves, short-retry runner lookup, surface better COMPATIBLE errors as 503,
and add fixture+live voice-shaped dispatch e2e (verify:agent-kernel:dispatch).

commits.headline: fix(agents): unbreak active delegate_task under build drift and invented caps
commits.body:
Voice delegation was failing closed when producer/worker SHAs drifted under
dev:all, and when the model invented free-form requirements.capabilities.
Prefer exact runner build match but fall back to same protocol+adapter;
filter unrecognized capabilities before runtime select; steer tool description.

commits.headline: fix(whatsapp): harden markdown conversion and chat-info logging

commits.headline: fix(voice): harden MLX listener replacement before re-bind

Only SIGTERM owned local mlx_lm.server processes, wait for those PIDs to
exit, keep the cold-load probe window before classifying wedged, and
never replace remote listeners.

injected `server*` into intentTools. Gate that path too, and mark
evernote-intent grantServerTools:false so guests cannot reach owner notes.

code work about those nouns stays on the change lane. Verify still beats

commits.headline: fix(agents): enforce judge recall cap and align routed timeouts
commits.body:

2 recalls" prompt instruction had no runtime backing (executor defaults
to 10), and the standard/local-fast routes in question-router.js pass
an explicit timeoutMs (30s/15s) that bypasses judge-question.js's new

judge regardless of tier.

finalization and land as an unscorable "error" decision instead of a
real answer/escalate outcome.

commits.headline: fix(trial-g): restore hover-residual angular decay
commits.body:

for a selected/thrown release), but TrialGFlightEnvelope routed both
the persistent throw envelope and the transient hover-residual
envelope through the same unconditional path. That made the hover
residual spin armed in EndLassoDrive persist indefinitely instead of
decaying with HoverResidualHalfLife.

commits.headline: fix(respond): narrow structured-path fallback to body-shape errors only
commits.body:
Limit the 4xx fallback to [400, 415, 422] (request body rejected by the
server) instead of the full 400-499 range. Auth errors (401/403), missing
endpoints (404), and rate limits (429) should propagate to the caller, not
silently retry on the text path.
